title: ngx-json-render MCP App schematic
description: Generates an MCP App for a catalog: an Angular view project, its MCP server, and an mcp target that builds both.

name.description: The name of the view's application project; the build lands in dist/<name>.

catalog.description: The catalog the model may use, as <file>#<export> relative to the workspace root, such as "src/app/catalog.ts#catalog". The server imports it in Node, so the file must not import Angular. Leave it out for the Angular Material catalog when ngx-json-render-material is installed, or a starter catalog otherwise.

registry.description: The registry that renders the catalog, as <file>#<export>, such as "src/app/registry.ts#registry". Required with --catalog.
